correctness.rationale: For m>=1, d_ij=m(1-R_ij) converts the exact Łukasiewicz transitivity inequalities to the six directed triangle inequalities on integers 0..m. Conditioning on four distances yields independent exact intervals for the last two, so equation (1) counts every admissible frame once. The full-dimensional rational six-polytope is bounded by eighteen explicit integer halfspaces. Exact Fraction elimination of all 18564 six-facet combinations certifies 31 vertices, 29 integral and two half-integral; every vertex is found by a nonsingular active set. The rational Ehrhart theorem gives polynomial degree <=6 on each parity, and direct fourfold sums at fourteen values certify unique seven-point interpolation on each parity. The parity correction is nonzero, giving minimal period 2. Independently, all six variables are enumerated directly at m=0..3. These computational checks prove a finite certificate; the infinite statement additionally uses the mathematical Ehrhart theorem.
